QCF Angers

3R+F
10 players
Vincent Ripoll
vekn.net/event-calendar/event/8111

Deck name: Women in chains
Description: An evolution of my Gangrel dominate deck, mixed with my Gang of Fur deck (with no dominate at all) and a big deal of inspiration from Martin Weinmayer's deck. Ingrid Rossler is very important since it's probably the first vampire you'll bring out in order to play Parity Shift and to accelerate the influence of the other vampires.
